**Primary Provenance Sources:** `results/registry/master_ledger.sqlite`, `results/registry/master_ledger.jsonl`, `results/SEQLEN_SCALING_MASTER.csv`, `results/pareto_table.csv`, `results/master_aggregated_results.csv`, `results/master_benchmark_summary.csv`

## 1. Executive Summary & Verification Taxonomy

This unified master index represents the cross-verified empirical results across all architectural categories, including subquadratic attentions, matrix compression engines, native 3-level CUDA operators, Triton JIT accelerated kernels, and distillation/homotopy ablations. Hardware tests were executed on NVIDIA RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (SM 8.9) under CUDA 12.x and PyTorch 2.4.x.

### Category Distribution

| Architecture Category | Total Verified Modules | Target Operational Domain |
|:---|:---:|:---|
| `attention` | 467 | Subquadratic, linear, recurrent, gated, and state-space attention mechanisms |
| `compressor` | 101 | SVD, Tucker, Tensor-Train, Kronecker, and structured weight/activation compressors |
| `cuda_kernel` | 18 | Native 3-level C++/CUDA fused operators for subquadratic scans and linear algebra |
| `triton_kernel` | 40 | JIT-compiled Triton kernels optimizing SRAM residency and memory bandwidth |
| `ablation` | 2 | Homotopy sweeps, compounding error mitigation, and 6-Pillar KD suites |
| `baseline` | 1 | Dense uncompressed teacher baseline models (BERT/RoBERTa/GPT-2) |
